name: Moth
overview: The Bible uses the moth both literally and figuratively to illustrate the fragility and impermanence of human life and earthly possessions. In Job and Psalms, the moth symbolizes decay and destruction, consuming garments and beauty as a reminder of human vanity and mortality. Isaiah emphasizes that just as moths eat away at clothing, so will worldly things fade away, contrasting this with the enduring nature of God's righteousness and salvation.
